--help:
usage: dubadabidu [-h] [--langs LANGS]
                  [--from {s1_extract,s2_transcribe,s3_translate,s4_synthesize,s5_fit,s6_mix,s7_subtitles,s8_mux}]
                  [--to {s1_extract,s2_transcribe,s3_translate,s4_synthesize,s5_fit,s6_mix,s7_subtitles,s8_mux}]
                  [--engine {qwen,edge}] [--spec SPEC] [--no-mux] [--force] [--keep-alive]
                  [--reuse] [--keep-going] [--apply] [--budget BUDGET] [--project PROJECT]
                  [--config CONFIG] [--overlay OVERLAY] [-v]
                  {run,stage,qc,doctor,report,evaluate,review,tune,prep,preamble,batch,autopilot,verdicts,bakeoff,remote,refit,migrate}
                  [rest ...]

positional arguments:
  {run,stage,qc,doctor,report,evaluate,review,tune,prep,preamble,batch,autopilot,verdicts,bakeoff,remote,refit,migrate}
  rest

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --langs LANGS
  --from {s1_extract,s2_transcribe,s3_translate,s4_synthesize,s5_fit,s6_mix,s7_subtitles,s8_mux}
  --to {s1_extract,s2_transcribe,s3_translate,s4_synthesize,s5_fit,s6_mix,s7_subtitles,s8_mux}
                        stop after this stage (e.g. --to s7_subtitles to produce audio+subs but
                        skip mux — the remote GPU path muxes locally so the source video never
                        uploads)
  --engine {qwen,edge}
  --spec SPEC           acceptance spec for `autopilot` (default specs/batch.yaml)
  --no-mux              `autopilot`: stop at s7 (audio+subs), skip the mux — the remote GPU path
                        muxes locally so the source video never uploads
  --force               discard a cache so a changed setting re-applies. `stage s3_translate`:
                        drop translations + terms for --langs (provider switch). `stage
                        s4_synthesize` or a `run` reaching s4: drop cached takes for --langs so
                        take-SELECTION params (best_of, min_f0st, ...) re-apply — they're not in
                        synth_hash, so the cache ignores them otherwise. Keeps translations +
                        human verdicts.
  --keep-alive          `remote`: do NOT terminate the pod when the task ends, so a failing engine
                        install can be debugged IN PLACE over SSH instead of paying a fresh ~4min
                        bootstrap per attempt. Prints the ssh command. The pod-side watchdog still
                        self-destructs at the deadline; `remote kill` ends it sooner.
  --reuse               `remote`: attach to the pod a previous --keep-alive run left running
                        instead of provisioning a new one. Skips the bootstrap, whose torch
                        download is 4-6 GB and took anywhere from 4 to 60 min depending on the
                        pod's route to PyPI. Falls back to provisioning if no live pod is tracked.
  --keep-going          `run` over several videos: log a failing video and continue with the next
                        instead of stopping
  --apply               `migrate`: write the changes (default: a dry run that only lists them)
  --budget BUDGET       hard USD cap for `remote` (auto-terminates the pod); default
                        runpod.budget_usd
  --project PROJECT     project directory (config.yaml, glossary/, ref/, work/, .env); default
                        $DUBADABIDU_HOME, else the nearest directory above the cwd that holds
                        config.yaml
  --config CONFIG
  --overlay OVERLAY     yaml deep-merged over --config; REPEATABLE, applied left-to-right (later
                        wins). Compose independent axes, e.g. GPU/TTS + translation provider:
                        --overlay config.gpu.yaml --overlay config.deepseek.yaml
  -v, --verbose
